name: zordon
description: Local dev-stack supervisor (databases, brokers, services) declared in an Alphasfile, run as host processes — auto-registers the `zordon mcp` server so agents can start/stop the stack, inspect it, and run declared provisions without shelling out, and shows the stack in a live sidecar dashboard pane.
suggestedPrompts: Show the status of this project's zordon stack
Create an isolated zordon workspace and start the stack
Run the declared provisions for this stack via zordon MCP
